name: Pit Wall
author: Jeremy Longshore
description: Pit Wall turns your Omarchy bar into a Formula 1 race-weekend command post. Between sessions it counts down to FP1, qualifying, sprint, or race start; once running it shows the leader, gaps, flags, safety-car state, and a live leaderboard. Open the panel for the full weekend in local time plus driver and constructor standings. It reads keyless Jolpica schedule and standings data every 15 minutes and OpenF1 every 20 seconds only during sessions. No account, token, telemetry, writes, or user data.
